_comment: npm audit allowlist for api/ — reviewed exceptions only.
_policy: Allowlisted advisories MUST include the advisory ID, affected package, severity, and a short justification. Each entry is reviewed during PR. High/critical advisories may only be allowlisted when: (a) the vulnerable code path is not reachable, or (b) a fix does not yet exist upstream. Remove entries as soon as a patched version is available.
